name: UPGRADER - Upgrade your skins!
desc:
🎲 Welcome to the UPGRADER - Improve your skins! 

[🎁] Promo codes: NewGame, Upgrader → 1,500, 1,000 in-game currency! 
[🎁] Subscribe to our TB1STEP group to earn more money in Clicker! 

[👑] UPDATE - BETA 1.3


[🔼] Improve items - Try to increase the rarity of your item by 2X, 4X or 8X times 
[🎯] Visit every day and claim the daily wheel and daily prizes for time! 
[📅] Updates: every 3-10 days! 

[ ⚠️ ] Important: the game uses virtual currency. This is a simulation - all items and improvements stay within the game. The atmosphere is created for fun and to practice luck!


[👑] Thank you to Valve for the inspiring skins.
